newsitem.title: LIBERIA: Liberian warlord Kromah arrested over arms - army.
newsitem.headline: Liberian warlord Kromah arrested over arms - army.

text.p: One of Liberia's main warlords and presidential candidates Alhaji Kromah was arrested on Friday after peacekeepers found a large cache of arms at his home, the African peacekeeping force said.
"We have placed him under arrest in his house but I have now ordered that he be brought to the force's mess," the commander of the ECOMOG peacekeeping force, Major Victor Malu, told reporters.

"The arms were right in his house and include anti-aircraft guns and brand new rifles still in their packaging," he said, adding that it took three large trucks to move the weapons to ECOMOG's headquarters.

Malu told a news conference an ECOMOG task force carried out a surprise search of the homes of all four principal warlords in Liberia's civil war, including Charles Taylor, another presidential candidate. Only Kromah's house turned up weapons.

Liberia's warring factions have officially been disbanded and all weapons were supposed to have been surrendered by a January 31 deadline under a peace plan to end seven years of civil war. Elections are set for May 30.
